svg.title: CMD & CTRL
svg.desc: Source of truth for the rounded app icon. The mark is the one in src/lib/components/Wordmark.svelte (its 208-unit grid, centred on the diamond, times 1.65): four Cs, four players, around a diamond, the commander at the centre of the table. Drawn in the default skin, War room: the Cs in its accent (#ff7a1a) and the diamond in its text colour (#e8eff7), on its ink (#070d14). Regenerate the PNGs with client/tools/gen-icons.sh after editing.
